title: Providers, Properties, and Build Inputs Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies providers, properties, and build inputs?
options: Keep values as typed Providers or Properties until the consuming model or task requires them.
Convert all Providers to strings immediately
Read environment globals inside cacheable actions
Use mutable project extra properties as shared state
questions.answer: Keep values as typed Providers or Properties until the consuming model or task requires them.
questions.explanation: The correct approach preserves Gradle’s lazy model, explicit data flow, variant correctness, functional evidence and operability.

questions.prompt: Property convention prevents a build script from overriding the value.
questions.explanation: Calling provider.get at plugin application time defeats deferred calculation and can make unrelated commands fail because an optional value is absent.

questions.prompt: What does flatMap preserve that reading a file path early can lose?
questions.answer: Lazy calculation and producer dependency information carried by the nested Provider.
questions.explanation: The answer names the model property that makes the build behaviour predictable rather than relying on incidental script order.
